title: festuca ovina subsp. brevifolia
intro: Festuca ovina subsp. brevifolia, commonly known as sheep's fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca ovina subsp. brevifolia include wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system support, due to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins. The plant's bioactive constituents are responsible for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity against certain pathogens.
